text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro McQueen told me, "I'd like to practice our live performance," so when I headed to the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have been waiting for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is a new Racewear presented to me
in recognition of my achievements.
choice_data_list: Is the live practice also for your winning outfit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, that is part of it, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...See? I'm not the only one
who got a new racing outfit, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Tokai Teio's achievements were recognized around the same time,
and she received a new racing outfit as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She possesses footwork
second to none.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Then, we must make sure we don't look inferior
when standing alongside them."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...For the sake of this outfit, too.
And for everyone who supports me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sensing her strong sense of purpose, we decided to head over to the stage right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone was already on the stage.
......It was Tokai Teio herself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey everyone, how're you doing?
I'm just getting the hype started~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling smiles, bouncy steps—
For a moment, Mejiro McQueen and I
were completely captivated.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, what! If you were here, you should've just called out to me sooner~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry,
I was just a little startled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Both having obtained new Racewear,
it seems you two are thinking the exact same thing...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true! Now that I've got my Racewear,
I definitely, absolutely want to be number one
on stage too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I think McQueen's new racing silks suit her really well, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My racing outfit is super cool too!
I'm gonna stand out and burn hotter than anyone else~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I accept the challenge. Whether on the track
or on the stage... I absolutely will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, Tokai Teio finished her practice and left—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen stared after the retreating figure for a while.
—Her eyes held an unusually serious look.
choice_data_list: So you really respect them, huh.
So you really respect them, don't you?
Don't worry, you have your own unique strengths.
It's okay, you have your own strengths

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen stared after the retreating figure for a while.
—Her eyes held an unusually serious look.
choice_data_list: So you really respect them, huh.
So you really respect them, don't you?
Don't worry, you have your own unique strengths.
It's okay, you have your own strengths

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her steps from earlier.
Her brightness, her proactiveness—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And her fighting spirit never wavers.
There is so much I can learn from her.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best so we don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, after all, I just made a vow right in front of her. That I won't lose on stage either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please feast your eyes on my steps.
I promise to dance more gracefully than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dancing upon the stage with her fighting spirit blazing,
she was more elegant and filled with grace than anyone, just as promised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Fufu, that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "However, concretely speaking, what parts of it do you consider good?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: Her sense of responsibility is so strong it's a bit worrying at times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wha—at the very end...!
Is that supposed to be a compliment...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Well, very well. I cannot deny it either.
After all, I have caused quite a bit of trouble
for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I watched over her practice on stage.
...Making sure she took proper breaks, as she was
so focused on dancing gracefully.
